title: Binary Search Tree Insertion and Search
spec: Process a list of operations containing commands to insert or search for numbers in a binary search tree. The tree starts empty. For an insert command, traverse the tree going left if smaller and right if larger, adding a new node when the required child link is missing. For a search command, traverse similarly and return true if found, or false if the current node becomes missing. Track the root of the tree, checking if it is missing before starting any traversal. Include finding the minimum and maximum values; to find the minimum, keep going left until the left child is missing, and to find the maximum, keep going right until the right child is missing. Return a list of boolean results for the search operations.

title: Doubly Linked List Manager
spec: Manage a sequence of numbers using a doubly linked list. Supported commands are push front, push back, pop front, and pop back. For pushing to the front, handle the case where the head is missing, and if it is not missing, update its previous pointer. For pushing back, handle the case where the tail is missing, and if it is not missing, update its next pointer. For popping, if the list becomes empty, update both head and tail to be missing. Return a list of the popped values, using zero if a pop was attempted on a missing node.

title: Quadtree Point Insertion
spec: Build a quadtree from a list of two dimensional points. Each node divides space into four quadrants representing top left, top right, bottom left, and bottom right. Start with a root node initially missing. When inserting a point, check if the root is missing to create it. Otherwise, determine the correct quadrant. If the child for that quadrant is missing, create a new node there. After building the tree, write a recursive function to count all points that explicitly checks if each of the four quadrant children is not missing before traversing into them. Return the final count of points.

title: Configuration Settings Merger
spec: Merge a list of configuration layers where each layer contains exactly five specific settings for host, port, username, password, and timeout. A missing setting is represented by a missing value. Start with a base configuration of all missing values. Iterate through the layers. For the host setting, if the new layer value is not missing, update the base host. Write the exact same explicit check independently for the port, username, password, and timeout settings. Finally, apply default fallback values by checking if each base setting is still missing. Return the final resolved configuration tuple.

title: Lowest Common Ancestor
spec: Construct a binary tree from a list of relationships, then find the lowest common ancestor for a given list of query pairs. A recursive search function should check if the current node is missing, returning missing if so. It should search the left and right subtrees. After the recursive calls, check the results. If both left and right results are not missing, the current node is the ancestor. If the left result is missing but the right is not missing, return the right result. Perform the inverse check for the left side. Return a list of ancestor values.

title: Autocomplete Prefix Tree
spec: Build a prefix tree from a list of strings to support autocomplete. Each node holds an array of twenty six children, initially all missing, and a boolean end of word flag. To insert a string, check if the corresponding child index is missing and create a node if needed. To search for a prefix, traverse the tree; if a child is missing at any point, return an empty list. After finding the prefix node, gather all valid words by recursively visiting all twenty six children, explicitly checking if each child is not missing before descending. Return a list of suggestions.

title: Markdown Document Parser
spec: Parse a list of text lines into a document structure. Track the current paragraph block, the current list block, and the current blockquote, all initially missing. Iterate through the lines. If a line starts with a dash, check if the list block is missing to create it, and check if the paragraph block is not missing to close it. If a line is blank, explicitly check if the paragraph block, list block, and blockquote are not missing, and close them by setting them to missing. Return a count of each block type created during the parsing process.

title: Legacy Database Migrator
spec: Migrate a list of database rows to a new schema. Each row has eight columns representing legacy user data which can all be missing. Write explicit logic for each column. If the legacy username is missing, generate a placeholder. If the primary email is missing, check if the secondary email is not missing and use it. If the date of birth is missing, assign a default epoch time. If the subscription status is missing, set it to inactive. Check if the billing address is not missing; if so, ensure the shipping address is not missing, otherwise copy the billing address. Return a list of migrated rows.

title: Task Scheduler with Optional Attributes
spec: Schedule a sequence of tasks where each task is a tuple of identifier, predecessor, duration, deadline, priority, and assignee. Any of these attributes can be missing. Check if the predecessor is missing to allow the task to start immediately. If the duration is missing, set it to a default of one hour. If the deadline is not missing, calculate the time slack. If the priority is missing, set it to low. If the assignee is missing, assign the task to the system administrator. Return a list of fully populated task tuples.

title: Nested Object Differencing
spec: Compare a list of pairs where each pair contains an old record and a new record. Each record is a list with six elements representing identifier, status, price, quantity, category, and remarks. Any element can be missing. For each pair, check the six fields individually. For status, if the old is missing and the new is not missing, count it as an addition. For price, if both are not missing, calculate the numeric difference. If remarks is missing in the new record but not missing in the old, flag it as deleted. Write explicit missing checks for every field. Return a list of change summaries.

title: Min Priority Queue Operations
spec: Implement a min priority queue using a binary tree of nodes instead of an array. Each node has a value, parent, left child, and right child. When inserting, find the first node where a left or right child is missing. Sift the new node up by swapping values if its parent is not missing and is larger. For extraction, swap the root with the last inserted node, remove the leaf by setting its parent child pointer to missing, and sift down by comparing with children that are not missing. Return a list of extracted minimums.

title: Invoice Data Cleaner
spec: Clean a list of invoice records. Each record has a subtotal, tax, discount, shipping, total, and currency. Any value can be missing. Write an explicit check for every single field to fill in gaps. If the currency is missing, set it to dollars. If the subtotal is missing but the total and tax are not missing, deduce the subtotal. If the discount is missing, set it to zero. If the shipping is missing, set it to a standard rate. If the total is missing, calculate it only if the subtotal and tax are not missing. Return a list of the cleaned invoices.

title: Doubly Linked LRU Cache
spec: Implement a least recently used cache using a doubly linked list. Each node has a key, value, previous pointer, and next pointer. When moving an accessed node to the front, check if its previous pointer is not missing to bypass it, and if its next pointer is not missing to stitch the list together. Update the cache head and tail pointers, checking if they are missing when the list is empty. If the cache reaches capacity, remove the tail node, handling the case where its previous pointer might be missing. Return a list of cache hits and misses.

title: Contact Book Merging
spec: Process a list of contact updates where each update is a tuple of identifier, first name, last name, email, phone number, and physical address. Any field except the identifier can be missing. Group the updates by identifier. For each group, start with all five optional fields as missing. Iterate through the updates. If the new first name is not missing, update the stored first name. Write the exact same independent check for the last name, email, phone number, and physical address. Return a list of fully merged contacts, leaving missing fields intact.

title: HTML Document Tree Search
spec: Search for specific tags in a simplified document object model tree. Each element has a tag name, text content, class name, identifier, parent, first child, and next sibling. Write a function to find an element by identifier which traverses the tree checking if the identifier is not missing and matches. Write another function to collect all text content by traversing children and siblings, appending the text if it is not missing. Ensure you check if the first child is not missing before descending, and if the next sibling is not missing before advancing. Return a list of found text strings.

title: Binary Search Tree Deletion
spec: Implement a binary search tree that supports node deletion. Find the target node first. If the node to delete has a missing left child, replace it with its right child. If its right child is missing, replace it with its left child. If neither child is missing, find the minimum node in the right subtree by traversing left until the left child is missing. Replace the target value with this minimum value, and then recursively delete the minimum node. Also check if the root itself is missing before attempting any deletion. Return the tree in order traversal after all deletions.

title: Nested Menu Navigation
spec: Simulate a user navigating a nested menu system. The menu is a tree where each node has a string label, an optional parent menu, an optional left sibling, an optional right sibling, and an optional first child. Start at the root. Process a list of action strings like go up, go down, go left, and go right. For go up, check if the parent is not missing before moving. For go down, check if the first child is not missing. Handle left and right by explicitly checking if the respective siblings are not missing. Return a list of the labels visited.

title: Employee Record Normalizer
spec: Normalize a list of employee records containing first name, middle name, last name, preferred name, department, manager, and office location. Any field can be missing. Check if the middle name is missing; if so, replace it with an empty string. If the preferred name is missing, use the first name. If the department is missing, assign it to a general pool. If the manager is missing, assign the administrative head. If the office location is missing but the department is not missing, assign a default location based on the department. Return a list of formatted employee strings.

title: Incomplete Log File Parser
spec: Parse a list of string log lines containing optional fields for date, time, severity, user, internet address, and message. Keep track of the last seen value for each of the six fields, initially all missing. For each line, extract whatever fields are present. Explicitly check if the date is missing in the current line, and if so, check if the last seen date is not missing and use it. Write the exact same missing value checks independently for the time, severity, user, and internet address fields to reconstruct the full context. Return a list of fully reconstructed log lines.

title: Threaded Binary Tree Construction
spec: Construct a threaded binary search tree from a sequence of numbers. A threaded node has left and right children, and boolean flags indicating if the child pointers are threads to predecessor or successor nodes. When inserting, standard rules apply until a child is missing. Instead of leaving the child missing, add the new node and set its threads to point to the ancestors. Write an in order traversal that starts by going left until the left child is missing or is a thread. Follow the right threads, explicitly checking if the right child is missing at the extreme right. Return the traversal order.

title: Abstract Syntax Tree Formatter
spec: Format a list of abstract syntax tree nodes into code strings. Each node is a tuple containing a node type, and five optional fields for left expression, right expression, operator, identifier name, and literal value. Depending on the node type, check the fields. If the type is an assignment, check that the identifier is not missing and the right expression is not missing. If it is a binary operation, ensure the left, right, and operator are not missing. If it is a literal, check that the literal value is not missing. Return a list of formatted code strings.

title: Blockchain Block Validator
spec: Process a list of blocks where each block has a previous hash, a timestamp, a transaction payload, a miner signature, and a nonce. The genesis block has a missing previous hash. For all other blocks, check if the previous hash is missing and reject if so. Check if the timestamp is missing. If the transaction payload is missing, allow it but log a warning. If the miner signature is not missing, verify it against the payload. If the nonce is missing, assign a default of zero. Check if the entire block is missing due to a network error. Return a list of boolean validation results.

title: Property Listing Parser
spec: Parse a list of real estate listings. Each listing has a price, bedroom count, bathroom count, square footage, year built, garage capacity, and pool flag. Any can be missing. Explicitly check if the price is missing and skip the listing if so. If the bedroom count is missing, assume one. If the bathroom count is missing but bedrooms are not missing, set bathrooms equal to bedrooms. If square footage is missing, estimate it based on bedrooms. If year built is missing, flag as unknown. If garage capacity is missing, set to zero. Return a list of standardized listing tuples.

title: User Registration Validator
spec: Validate a list of user registration requests. Each request has eight fields for username, password, email, age, phone, address, city, and zip code. Any field might be missing. Write a validation sequence that explicitly checks each field. If the username is missing, reject it. If the email is missing but the phone is not missing, allow it. If both email and phone are missing, reject it. If the age is missing, assign a default of eighteen. If the address is not missing, check that the city and zip code are also not missing. Return a list of boolean results for each registration attempt.

title: Binary Tree Serialization
spec: Convert a sequence of binary tree operations into a tree, serialize it to a list, and deserialize it back. For serialization, perform a preorder traversal; if the current node is missing, append a special missing marker and return. Otherwise append the value and recursively process the left and right children, explicitly checking if they are not missing to optimize the traversal, though the base missing check must remain. For deserialization, use an iterator over the list; if the next value is the marker, return missing. Otherwise create a node and recursively assign the left and right children. Return the root value of the reconstructed tree.

title: Sensor Data Interpolator
spec: Write a program to process environmental sensor data using the entry function `interpolate(readings)`. The input is a list of dictionaries representing sensor readings, where each has a timestamp and five optional measurements: temperature, humidity, wind speed, atmospheric pressure, and light intensity. The function must iterate through the readings and maintain the most recently seen valid value for each of the five measurements, all initially starting with no value. For each reading, if a measurement is strictly missing (null), it should be replaced by the most recent valid value for that measurement. If there is no previous valid value yet because it is the beginning of the sequence, it remains missing. It is important to distinguish a missing value from a valid reading of zero. The function must return a new list of dictionaries with the filled values. Example input: a reading with a timestamp of one and all measurements missing, followed by a reading with a timestamp of two and a temperature of twenty. Output: the first reading remains unchanged, the second reading keeps the temperature of twenty.

title: Financial Portfolio Rebalancer
spec: Implement a portfolio adjustment tool with the entry function `rebalance(assets)`. The input is a list of asset dictionaries, each having a ticker symbol and five optional numerical fields: current price, target allocation percentage, current shares, minimum lot size, and maximum allowed shares. The function must evaluate each asset to determine how many shares to buy or sell. It first checks if the current price or target allocation is missing (null); if either is strictly missing, the asset is skipped. It then tracks a running total of the portfolio value, but only includes assets where the current shares and current price are both provided. Next, it calculates the desired shares. If the minimum lot size is provided, the desired shares are rounded down to the nearest multiple. If the maximum allowed shares is provided, the desired shares are capped. The function returns a list of tuples containing the ticker and the recommended share adjustment. Example: an asset with price ten, target ten percent, and fifty shares, with all other fields missing, returns a calculation based solely on the available data.

title: E-commerce Order Fulfillment Tracker
spec: Design an order processing pipeline starting with `fulfill(orders)`. The function processes a list of order dictionaries, each containing an identifier and several optional details: a shipping address, a billing address, a tracking number, a selected carrier, an expedited shipping flag, and a required delivery date. The function must iterate over the orders and build a dispatch list. If the shipping address is missing (null), it falls back to the billing address; if both are missing, the order is marked as invalid. If the tracking number is missing, one is generated by combining the identifier with the carrier name, but only if the carrier is not missing. If the expedited flag is strictly missing, it defaults to false. If the required delivery date is missing, it is assigned a default date of seven days from now. The function also maintains a reference to the highest priority order seen so far, which starts as empty, updating it whenever an expedited order is found. It returns a tuple of the valid dispatch list and the highest priority order.

title: Medical Patient Record Summarizer
spec: Create a clinical data analyzer using the entry function `summarize(patients)`. The input is a list of patient visit dictionaries, each with a patient name and six optional clinical measurements: systolic blood pressure, diastolic blood pressure, heart rate, weight, height, and blood oxygen level. The function processes each visit to calculate a health risk score. A strictly missing measurement (null) must be handled differently than a zero value. If either systolic or diastolic blood pressure is missing, the blood pressure score is zero. If heart rate is missing, the heart rate score is zero, otherwise it is calculated based on standard ranges. If both weight and height are provided, a body mass index is calculated; if either is missing, the body mass index score is omitted. If blood oxygen level is missing, a warning flag is set. The function also tracks the most recent visit with a complete set of measurements, which starts as empty. It returns a list of computed scores for each visit.

title: Job Applicant Filter
spec: Build a candidate screening tool with the entry function `filter(applicants)`. The function evaluates a list of job application dictionaries, each having a candidate name and optional fields: highest degree, years of experience, portfolio link, reference contact, technical test score, and visa status. The function must filter and rank the candidates. If the degree is missing (null), it defaults to high school. If years of experience is missing, it defaults to zero. If the portfolio link is missing, a portfolio score of zero is assigned. If the reference contact is missing, a flag is added requiring a background check. If the technical test score is strictly missing, the application is rejected immediately, distinguishing a missing score from a valid zero score. If visa status is missing, it is assumed the candidate requires sponsorship. The function also keeps track of the candidate with the highest technical test score seen so far, starting from nothing, and returns a list of accepted candidates along with the top scorer.

title: Music Playlist Generator
spec: Develop an automated track sequencer using the entry function `generate(tracks)`. The input is a list of track dictionaries, each with a title and optional attributes: artist name, album name, genre, tempo in beats per minute, mood tag, and vocal language. The function builds a sequence of tracks adhering to specific rules. If the artist name is missing (null), the track is classified as unknown. If the genre is missing, it defaults to general pop. If the tempo is missing, the track cannot be used for the upbeat section of the playlist. If the mood tag is missing, it is derived from the tempo if available. If the vocal language is missing, it is assumed to be instrumental. The function maintains a reference to the last played track, initially empty, to ensure two tracks with the same artist are not played consecutively unless the artist is missing. It returns a list of titles representing the final playlist order.

title: IoT Device Fleet Manager
spec: Write a telemetry processing service starting with `manage(devices)`. The input is a list of device dictionaries, where each reports an identifier and optional state variables: firmware version, last heartbeat timestamp, error code, geographic zone, battery voltage, and signal strength. The function identifies devices needing maintenance. If the firmware version is missing (null), it is flagged for a mandatory update. If the last heartbeat is missing, the device is considered offline. If the error code is missing, the device is assumed healthy, but a valid zero error code means a recent recovery and requires a log entry. If the geographic zone is missing, it defaults to a global unassigned pool. If battery voltage is missing, power state cannot be determined and a warning is generated. If signal strength is missing, network diagnostics are skipped. The function tracks the device with the lowest battery voltage, starting empty, and returns a list of maintenance actions alongside the most depleted device.

title: Online Quiz Scorer
spec: Create a grading system using the entry function `score(submissions)`. It calculates final grades for a list of student submission dictionaries. Each submission has a student identifier and several optional fields: multiple choice score, essay text, feedback request flag, late penalty percentage, bonus points, and a manual override score. If the manual override score is provided, it completely replaces all other calculations. Otherwise, the final score is computed by adding the multiple choice score, which defaults to zero if missing (null). If the essay text is missing, the essay score is zero; otherwise it gets full points. If the feedback request flag is missing, it defaults to false. If the late penalty is missing, no penalty is applied. If bonus points are strictly missing, none are added, which is distinct from a valid zero bonus. The function tracks the highest scoring student, starting with an empty reference, and returns a list of final grades.

title: Subscription Billing Engine
spec: Implement an invoicing tool with the entry function `bill(accounts)`. The function processes monthly charges for a list of customer account dictionaries. Each account has a customer name and optional billing details: active subscription plan, trial end date, stored payment method, promotional discount code, past due balance, and loyalty points. If the active plan is missing (null), no new charges are generated. If the trial end date is missing or has already passed, the full plan price is charged. If the payment method is missing, the account is marked for manual invoicing. If the discount code is missing, no discount is applied. If the past due balance is strictly missing, it is treated as zero, but a valid zero means it was recently paid off and triggers a thank you note. If loyalty points are missing, they accrue from zero. The function maintains a reference to the account with the highest total invoice, initially empty, and returns a list of generated invoices.

title: Fitness Workout Tracker
spec: Design a workout analysis utility starting with `analyze(exercises)`. The input is a list of exercise set dictionaries, each having a movement name and optional performance metrics: weight lifted, repetitions completed, rest duration before the set, perceived exertion rating, injury pain note, and video recording link. The function calculates the total volume and flags concerning sets. If the weight lifted is missing (null), it is assumed to be a bodyweight exercise. If repetitions are missing, the set is skipped as incomplete. If rest duration is missing, it defaults to a standard ninety seconds. If the perceived exertion rating is missing, intensity cannot be gauged. If an injury pain note is provided, the exercise is flagged for physical therapy review. If the video recording link is missing, form check is disabled. The function keeps track of the heaviest set performed, starting with nothing, and returns a summary of the workout volume and any flagged movements.

title: Project Management Kanban Board
spec: Create a task organization script using the entry function `organize(tasks)`. It updates the status of a list of task dictionaries in a project. Each task has a title and optional fields: assigned developer, due date, blocking issue, sprint identifier, estimated hours, and a completion timestamp. The function categorizes the tasks into appropriate columns. If the assigned developer is missing (null), the task goes to the backlog. If the blocking issue is provided, the task is moved to the blocked column. If the sprint identifier is missing, it cannot be added to the active board. If estimated hours are strictly missing, the task requires a sizing meeting, distinguishing it from a zero hour quick task. If the completion timestamp is missing, the task is considered in progress. If the due date is missing, it is given a low priority. The function tracks the earliest due task, initially empty, and returns a list of column assignments.

title: Delivery Route Optimizer
spec: Develop a logistics planner with the entry function `route(stops)`. The input is a list of stop dictionaries, each featuring a delivery address and optional constraints: time window start, time window end, required signature name, access gate code, fragile item flag, and a special delivery instruction. The function builds a sequential route plan. If the time window start is missing (null), the delivery can happen at any time before the end window. If the time window end is also missing, it is an anytime delivery. If the required signature name is provided, the stop is marked as requiring a recipient present. If the access gate code is missing, the driver must call the customer upon arrival. If the fragile item flag is missing, standard handling applies. If the special instruction is missing, standard drop off is used. The function remembers the last visited stop, starting empty, to calculate estimated travel times between stops, and returns the optimized schedule.

title: Movie Recommendation Engine
spec: Write a suggestion generator using the entry function `recommend(profiles)`. It processes a list of user profile dictionaries, each containing a user identifier and optional preferences: favorite director, preferred release decade, a genre to avoid, preferred streaming service, minimum rating threshold, and a parental control level. If the favorite director is missing (null), director based matching is skipped. If the preferred decade is missing, contemporary movies are suggested by default. If the genre to avoid is provided, all movies with that genre are filtered out. If the streaming service is missing, movies from all platforms are considered. If the minimum rating threshold is strictly missing, it defaults to an average rating. If the parental control level is missing, unrestricted content is allowed. The function tracks the most restrictive profile seen, initially empty, to generate a family friendly baseline, and returns a list of personalized suggestions for each user.

title: Real Estate Property Matcher
spec: Implement a listing filter with the entry function `match(listings)`. The input is a list of real estate listing dictionaries, each having an address and optional details: asking price, number of bedrooms, number of bathrooms, square footage, homeowner association fee, and a year built. The function evaluates the suitability of each listing. If the asking price is missing (null), the listing is discarded as incomplete. If bedrooms or bathrooms are missing, they default to one. If the square footage is missing, the price per square foot cannot be calculated. If the homeowner association fee is strictly missing, it is assumed to be zero, differentiating from an explicit zero fee which indicates a fee free community. If the year built is missing, age based filtering is ignored. The function maintains a reference to the best value listing found so far, starting empty, and updates it when a better price per square foot is found. It returns the matched listings.

title: University Course Prerequisite Checker
spec: Design an academic progress reviewer using the entry function `audit(students)`. The function evaluates a list of student profile dictionaries. Each profile contains a student name and optional academic records: declared major, declared minor, thesis topic, assigned academic advisor, expected graduation term, and an override code. The function determines if the students can register for senior seminars. If the declared major is missing (null), registration is blocked. If the declared minor is provided, additional interdisciplinary checks are performed. If the thesis topic is missing, a warning is issued to finalize it. If the assigned academic advisor is missing, the student is directed to the counseling center. If the expected graduation term is missing, the timeline cannot be verified. If the override code is provided, all previous restrictions are bypassed. The function tracks the student with the earliest graduation term, starting empty, and returns a list of registration decisions.

title: Game Character State Updater
spec: Create a combat turn processor with the entry function `update(characters)`. It handles a list of character dictionaries in a role playing game. Each character has a name and optional state attributes: current target enemy, active spell effect, movement destination, equipped mount, temporary health shield, and an environmental hazard condition. The function resolves actions for the turn. If the current target is missing (null), the character takes a defensive stance. If the active spell effect is provided, its duration is decremented. If the movement destination is missing, the character stays in place. If the equipped mount is missing, walking speed is used. If the temporary health shield is strictly missing, damage is taken directly to health points, distinguishing a missing shield from a depleted zero shield. If the environmental hazard is provided, passive damage is applied. The function tracks the last character to take damage, starting empty, and returns the updated combat states.

title: Smart Home Automation Engine
spec: Write a home control system using the entry function `evaluate(rules)`. It triggers actions based on a list of automation rule dictionaries. Each rule has a rule name and optional configuration parameters: trigger sensor identifier, time of day window, primary action device, fallback action device, notification message, and a cooldown timer. If the trigger sensor is missing (null), the rule is evaluated based solely on time. If the time window is missing, the rule is active all day. If the primary action device is missing, no physical action occurs. If the fallback action device is provided, it is used when the primary device is offline. If the notification message is missing, silent execution is assumed. If the cooldown timer is strictly missing, it defaults to one minute, differentiating from a zero minute immediate cooldown. The function maintains the last executed rule, which starts as empty, to prevent immediate duplicate executions. It returns a list of actions to dispatch.

title: Chess Tournament Pairer
spec: Develop a matchmaking algorithm with the entry function `pair(players)`. The input is a list of participant dictionaries in a chess tournament. Each player has a name and optional tournament data: international rating, designated title, club affiliation, requested half point bye, penalty deduction score, and pairing allocation number. If the international rating is missing (null), the player is considered unrated and placed at the bottom of their score group. If the designated title is provided, the player is flagged for the top boards. If the club affiliation is missing, conflicts with clubmates are ignored. If the requested half point bye is provided, the player is removed from the active pairing pool for the round. If the penalty deduction score is strictly missing, no penalty is applied, which is different from a valid zero deduction. If the pairing allocation number is missing, one is generated sequentially. The function tracks the highest rated unassigned player, starting empty, and returns the finalized matches.

title: Recipe Ingredient Scaler
spec: Implement a culinary measurement tool using the entry function `scale(ingredients)`. It adjusts the proportions of a list of ingredient dictionaries for a recipe. Each ingredient has a food name and optional measurements: base quantity, measurement unit, dietary substitute, preparation instruction, cooking temperature, and a sourcing link. The function multiplies quantities for a larger batch. If the base quantity is missing (null), it is treated as a garnish added to taste. If the measurement unit is missing, it defaults to whole items. If the dietary substitute is provided, an alternative recipe version is also generated. If the preparation instruction is missing, raw addition is assumed. If the cooking temperature is missing, room temperature is assumed. If the sourcing link is missing, standard grocery items are expected. The function keeps a reference to the most voluminous ingredient, initially empty, to determine the mixing bowl size required. It returns the adjusted recipe components.

title: Event Calendar Clash Detector
spec: Design a schedule analyzer starting with `detect(events)`. It checks a schedule of event dictionaries to find overlapping commitments. Each event has a title and optional scheduling details: start timestamp, end timestamp, physical location, virtual meeting link, assigned host, and required preparation time. If the start timestamp is missing (null), the event is considered unscheduled and skipped. If the end timestamp is missing, a default duration of one hour is added to the start time. If the physical location is missing, the event is assumed to be remote. If the virtual meeting link is provided alongside a missing physical location, remote status is confirmed. If the assigned host is missing, the primary account owner takes over. If the required preparation time is strictly missing, no buffer is added before the event, which is distinct from a zero buffer. The function tracks the previously processed event, which starts empty, to check for back to back clashes, and returns a list of scheduling conflicts.

title: Social Media Comment Thread Flattener
spec: Create a feed generator using the entry function `flatten(comments)`. It converts a nested list of comment dictionaries into a chronological feed. Each comment has text content and optional metadata: parent comment identifier, author username, timestamp, moderation warning flag, edit history link, and an upvote count. If the parent comment identifier is missing (null), the comment is treated as a top level post. If the author username is missing, it is displayed as anonymous. If the timestamp is missing, it is placed at the end of the current thread. If the moderation warning flag is provided, the content is hidden by default. If the edit history link is missing, the comment is marked as unedited. If the upvote count is strictly missing, it displays as hidden rather than zero. The function maintains a reference to the most upvoted top level comment, initially empty, and returns a flat list sorted for rendering.

title: Optional Dependency Resolver
spec: Write a package manager script with the entry function `resolve(packages)`. The input is a list of software package dictionaries. Each package has a name and optional requirements: primary target version, fallback compatible version, minimum system ram, designated patch link, conflicting package name, and a license key. If the primary target version is missing (null), the latest stable release is fetched. If the fallback compatible version is provided, it is stored in case the primary fails. If the minimum system ram is missing, standard memory limits are assumed. If the designated patch link is missing, no post installation scripts are run. If the conflicting package name is provided, an uninstall step is prepended. If the license key is strictly missing, the package runs in trial mode. The function tracks the package with the largest memory requirement, starting empty, and returns a list of installation instructions.

title: Library Catalog Search
spec: Implement a bibliographic lookup tool using the entry function `search(books)`. It processes a query across a list of book dictionaries. Each book has a title and optional bibliographic data: publication year, edition identifier, series title, volume number, cover image link, and a digital copy link. The function formats the search results for a user interface. If the publication year is missing (null), it is listed as unknown date. If the edition identifier is missing, first edition is assumed. If the series title is provided, the book is grouped under its franchise. If the volume number is missing while a series title exists, it is placed at the end of the series. If the cover image link is missing, a placeholder graphic is assigned. If the digital copy link is strictly missing, the book is marked as physical only. The function keeps track of the oldest book found, initially empty, and returns a structured list of formatted results.

title: Customer Support Ticket Router
spec: Develop an issue assignment system starting with `assign(tickets)`. It allocates a list of incoming customer issue dictionaries to appropriate agents. Each ticket has a description and optional routing tags: issue category, priority level, requested agent, required resolution time, customer loyalty tier, and a follow up phone number. If the issue category is missing (null), it is routed to the general queue. If the priority level is missing, standard priority is assigned. If the requested agent is provided, an attempt is made to bypass the queue directly to them. If the required resolution time is missing, a twenty four hour service level agreement applies. If the customer loyalty tier is missing, they are treated as a standard user. If the follow up phone number is strictly missing, email only communication is enforced. The function remembers the most urgent ticket processed so far, starting empty, and returns a list of agent assignments.

title: Podcast Episode Aggregator
spec: Create a media feed compiler with the entry function `aggregate(episodes)`. The input is a list of podcast episode dictionaries, each featuring a title and optional broadcast details: guest speaker name, audio duration, explicit content flag, transcript download link, sponsor message text, and a live stream recording timestamp. If the guest speaker name is missing (null), it is categorized as a solo episode. If the audio duration is missing, estimated listening time is unavailable. If the explicit content flag is provided, a content warning is prepended to the title. If the transcript download link is missing, accessibility features are disabled. If the sponsor message text is missing, ad breaks are skipped. If the live stream recording timestamp is strictly missing, it is considered a studio recorded episode. The function tracks the longest episode encountered, starting empty, and returns the aggregated media feed.

title: Spacecraft Telemetry Imputer
spec: Write a function `process(readings)` that takes a list of telemetry tuples. Each tuple contains timestamp, altitude, velocity, engine status string, and error code. Any of these elements except timestamp can be missing. Iterate through the list to fill missing values and generate a cleaned list. If altitude is missing, use the last seen altitude, or zero if no previous altitude exists. If velocity is missing, use the last seen velocity, but subtract ten to represent decay, or use zero if no previous exists. If the engine status string is missing, replace it with the string nominal. If the error code is present, record it in a separate tracking list, but do not alter the main tuple. Return a tuple containing the new list of completed telemetry tuples and the list of collected error codes.

title: Binary Expression Tree Evaluator
spec: Write a function `evaluate(nodes, root)` that resolves a mathematical tree. The nodes parameter is a dictionary mapping integer identifiers to node tuples. Each node tuple contains operation, left child, right child, numeric value, fallback value, and alternative operation. If the numeric value is present, return it immediately. If the left child is missing, try to return the fallback value; if the fallback value is also missing, the result is missing. If the right child is missing, try to use the fallback value; if it is missing, the result is missing. If the operation is missing, check the alternative operation. If the alternative operation is present, use it. If both operations are missing, the result is missing. Apply the chosen operation string to the left and right evaluated results.

title: Cascading Configuration Merger
spec: Write a function `merge(local, environment, default)` that takes three configuration tuples and returns a single merged tuple. Each tuple contains host name, port number, user name, password, and timeout duration. For the host name, check local, then environment, then default. If all are missing, use the string localhost. For the port number, check environment first, then local, then default; if all are missing, use eighty. For user name and password, check local then default; if user name is missing, use the string admin, and if password is missing, use the string secret. For timeout, check default then environment, using thirty if both are missing. Return the fully populated tuple of these five elements.

title: Patient Vitals Anomaly Detector
spec: Write a function `clean(records)` that processes a list of medical reading tuples. Each tuple has patient identifier, heart rate, systolic pressure, diastolic pressure, and oxygen saturation. If the patient identifier is missing, skip the record entirely. If the heart rate is present and greater than one hundred, add a warning string to a separate list. If the heart rate is missing, replace it with eighty. If the systolic pressure is missing, replace it with one hundred twenty. If the diastolic pressure is missing, replace it with eighty. If the oxygen saturation is missing, replace it with ninety eight. However, if both systolic pressure and diastolic pressure are missing simultaneously, you must discard the entire tuple. Return a tuple containing the cleaned list of records and the list of warnings.

title: Hotel Booking Allocator
spec: Write a function `allocate(requests, rooms)` to assign hotel rooms. Each request tuple contains customer identifier, minimum beds, preferred floor, preferred view, requires accessibility flag, and wants balcony flag. Each room tuple has room identifier, beds, floor, view, is accessible flag, and has balcony flag. If customer identifier is missing, ignore the request. If minimum beds is missing, assume zero. If preferred floor is present, it must match the room floor exactly. If preferred view is present, it must match exactly. If the requires accessibility flag is present and true, the room must be accessible. If the wants balcony flag is present and true, the room must have a balcony. Assign each request the first available matching room and return a list of paired identifiers.

title: Compiler Scope Resolution
spec: Write a function `resolve(name, scopes, start)` that looks up a variable name in nested compiler environments. The scopes parameter is a dictionary mapping scope identifiers to scope tuples. Each scope tuple contains variables dictionary, parent scope identifier, fallback scope identifier, and strict mode flag. Look up the name in the dictionary. If the value is missing, check the parent scope identifier. If the parent scope identifier is present, search that scope recursively. If the name is still not found, check the fallback scope identifier. If the fallback scope identifier is present, search there. If the strict mode flag is missing, you may finally check a special zero identifier scope; but if the flag is present, do not search the zero scope. If all fails, return a missing value.

title: Retail Order Price Calculator
spec: Write a function `calculate(orders)` to determine the final price for a list of retail orders. Each order tuple contains base price, discount amount, tax rate, shipping cost, gift wrap fee, coupon string, and loyalty points. If base price is missing, skip the order. If discount amount is missing, treat it as zero. If tax rate is missing, use zero point zero five. If shipping cost is missing, use ten. If gift wrap fee is present, add it to the total. If the coupon string is present, subtract five from the total. If loyalty points are present, subtract one for every hundred points. Return a list of the final calculated prices.

title: Robot Maze Path Validator
spec: Write a function `navigate(grid, start, moves)` to trace a robot path. The grid is a list of lists of integers, where missing values represent walls. The start parameter is a tuple of row and column. The moves parameter is a list of tuples containing row change, column change, energy required, required item, and optional bonus. Track the robot row, column, and total score. For each move, if energy required is missing, assume it takes zero. If required item is present, check if the score is greater than zero; if not, return a missing value. If optional bonus is present, add it to the score. If row change is missing, assume zero. If column change is missing, assume zero. If the grid cell at the new position is missing, the robot crashes and you must return a missing value. Return the final position tuple.

title: Database Left Join Emulator
spec: Write a function `join(left, right)` to merge records based on an identifier. Left tuples have identifier, name, age, and department. Right tuples have identifier, office, phone, salary, and bonus. For each left tuple, find the first matching right tuple by identifier. If the match is missing, output the left tuple combined with four missing values. If the match is present, process its fields. If the office is missing, use the string remote. If the phone is missing, use the string unlisted. If the salary is missing, use zero. If the bonus is present, add it to the salary. On the left side, if age is missing, use zero, and if department is missing, use the string general. Return a list of combined tuples.

title: Server Load Balancer
spec: Write a function `balance(servers)` to find the most available server. The input is a list of tuples containing server identifier, processor load, memory, active connections, disk space, and network bandwidth. If processor load is missing, skip the server. If memory is missing, skip the server. If active connections is missing, treat it as zero. If disk space is present and less than ten, skip the server. If network bandwidth is missing, treat it as one hundred. Calculate the score as processor load plus memory plus active connections. Track the lowest score and the best server identifier. The initial lowest score and best server identifier must start as missing. Return the best server identifier.

title: Exam Grader With Exemptions
spec: Write a function `grade(students)` to compute averages. The input is a list of tuples containing student identifier, math score, science score, literature score, art score, and physical education score. Calculate the total score and subjects taken. If the math score is missing, the student automatically fails; record a string failed for them. If the science score is present, add it; if missing, it has no penalty. If literature is missing, replace it with fifty and add to the total. If art is present, add it; if missing, add ten bonus points to the total instead of treating it as a subject. If physical education is missing, assume they scored one hundred and add to the total. Divide the total by the counted subjects and return a list of tuples with the identifier and final average.

title: Dietary Goal Tracker
spec: Write a function `track(meals, goals)` to compare food intake against targets. The meals parameter is a list of tuples containing calories, protein, carbohydrates, fat, sugar, and sodium. Accumulate totals. If a meal calories value is missing, estimate it by adding protein times four, carbohydrates times four, and fat times nine, assuming none of those three are missing; if any of those three are also missing, skip the meal entirely. If sugar is missing, treat it as zero. If sodium is missing, treat it as zero. The goals parameter is a tuple of the same six categories. For each category, if the goal is present, the accumulated total must be less than or equal to the goal. Return true if all present goals are met, otherwise false.

title: Astronomical Object Classifier
spec: Write a function `classify(stars)` that categorizes a list of celestial bodies. Each star is a tuple containing mass, radius, luminosity, surface temperature, spectral class, and magnetic field. If the mass is missing, the classification is unknown. If the radius is missing, substitute it with mass multiplied by two. If the luminosity is missing, calculate it from radius and surface temperature; but if surface temperature is also missing, the classification is unknown. If spectral class is present, append it to the classification string. If the magnetic field is missing, assume it is weak, otherwise strong. Return a list of the classification strings for all stars.

title: Network Device Config Merger
spec: Write a function `configure(device, template)` that combines two network configurations. Both are tuples containing internet protocol address, subnet mask, gateway, domain name server, and time server. For the internet protocol address, if the device value is missing, you must immediately return a missing value because it is mandatory. For the subnet mask, if the device value is missing, use the template value; if that is also missing, use the string default. For the gateway, check the template first, then the device. For the domain name server, if the device is present, use it; otherwise, if the template is present, use it; otherwise use eight eight eight eight. For the time server, if the device is missing, leave it missing regardless of the template. Return the newly formed configuration tuple.

title: Family Tree Descendant Filter
spec: Write a function `ancestors(people, target)` that finds all direct ancestors. The people parameter is a list of tuples containing person identifier, name, mother identifier, father identifier, spouse identifier, and guardian identifier. Start with the target identifier in a queue. When processing an identifier, fetch their tuple. If the mother identifier is present, add it to the queue. If the father identifier is present, add it to the queue. If the spouse identifier is present, add it to a separate spouses list. If the guardian identifier is present, and both the mother and father identifiers are missing, add the guardian to the queue. Track visited identifiers. Return a tuple of the ancestors set and the spouses list.

title: Audio Track Mixer
spec: Write a function `mix(primary, secondary)` to merge two digital audio tracks. Each track is a list of tuples representing samples. Each tuple has amplitude, frequency, phase, and channel type. If primary amplitude is missing, use secondary amplitude; if both are missing, use zero. If primary frequency is missing, use secondary frequency. If primary phase is present, use it, else use zero. If channel type is missing in the primary sample, check the secondary sample; if it is present in the secondary use it, else use the string mono. Combine these chosen values into a new sample tuple and return the list of mixed sample tuples.

title: Vehicle Telematics Dashboard
spec: Write a function `monitor(readings)` to generate alerts from vehicle sensors. The input is a list of tuples containing speed, revolutions per minute, engine temperature, tire pressure, oil pressure, and battery voltage. If speed is missing, use the previous speed, or zero. If revolutions per minute is missing, calculate it as speed multiplied by thirty. If engine temperature is missing, do not trigger any temperature alerts. If engine temperature is present and over one hundred, generate a hot alert. If tire pressure is missing, use thirty two. If oil pressure is missing and revolutions per minute is present and over two thousand, generate an oil warning. If battery voltage is missing, generate a battery warning. Return the list of generated alert strings.

title: Real Estate Valuation Engine
spec: Write a function `appraise(property)` to calculate the estimated value of a home. The input is a tuple containing base price, pool value, garage value, garden value, finished basement value, and solar panel value. If the base price is missing, return a missing value. Add the pool value if it is present. Add the garage value if it is present. Add the garden value if it is present. If the finished basement value is missing but the garage value is present, add two thousand. If the solar panel value is present, add it, but if it is missing and the pool value is present, subtract one thousand. If the garden value is missing and the pool value is missing, subtract five thousand. Return the final appraisal integer.

title: Bank Loan Scorer
spec: Write a function `score(applicant)` to evaluate a loan application. The applicant parameter is a tuple containing primary income, spouse income, collateral value, credit score, guarantor income, and employment months. If primary income is missing, reject the application. If spouse income is present, add it to total income. If collateral value is missing, require total income over fifty thousand and employment months over sixty; if employment months is missing, reject. If credit score is missing, require guarantor income to be present and over thirty thousand. If guarantor income is present, add half of it to total income. Return true if approved, false otherwise.

title: Logistics Freight Estimator
spec: Write a function `estimate(freight)` to calculate shipping costs. The freight parameter is a tuple containing weight, volume, hazardous fee, insurance fee, express fee, and customs fee. The base cost is weight times ten. If weight is missing, base cost is volume times five. If volume is also missing, return a missing value. If the hazardous fee is present, add it. If the insurance fee is missing, add a default of fifty, otherwise add the present fee. If the express fee is present, add it. If the customs fee is missing, but the hazardous fee is present, add an extra one hundred. Return the final total cost.

title: Social Media Engagement Rater
spec: Write a function `rate(posts)` to analyze content performance. The input is a list of tuples containing view count, like count, share count, comment count, bookmark count, and report count. For each post, if the view count is missing, the engagement rate is missing. If the like count is missing, use zero. If the share count is missing, use zero. If the comment count is missing, use zero. Sum these three. If the bookmark count is present, add it to the sum. If the report count is present, subtract it from the sum. Divide the final sum by the view count to get the rate. Return a list of the rates.

title: Data Record Validator
spec: Write a function `validate(record, schema)` to verify dictionary contents. The record is a dictionary mapping string keys to arbitrary values. The schema is a dictionary mapping string keys to rule tuples containing expected type, required flag, default value, minimum value, and maximum value. Fetch the value from the record. If the retrieved value is missing and the required flag is true, return false. If the retrieved value is missing and the default value is present, set the value to default. If the value is present and the minimum value is present, return false if the value is less than the minimum. If the maximum value is present, return false if the value is greater than the maximum. Return true if all checks pass.

title: Text Line Wrapper
spec: Write a function `wrap(words, properties, limit)` to organize text. The words parameter is a list of strings or missing values. The properties parameter is a matching list of tuples containing font weight, text color, underline flag, and strike flag. If a word is missing, force a new line. If the font weight is present and equals the string bold, the word takes two extra spaces. If the text color is missing, assume black. If the underline flag is present, add one extra space. If the strike flag is present, ignore the word entirely and do not add it to the line. Line lengths must not exceed the limit. Return a list of formatted line strings.

title: Pagination Cursor Aggregator
spec: Write a function `aggregate(responses, start)` to collect all data pages. The responses parameter is a dictionary mapping cursor identifiers to page tuples. Each page tuple contains a data items list, next cursor, previous cursor, total pages, and error message. Look up the current cursor. If the current cursor is missing, stop. If the error message is present in the tuple, log it and stop. If the data items list is missing, assume it is empty and append nothing. If the next cursor is present, update the current cursor. Otherwise, if total pages is present and greater than one, use the previous cursor as a fallback. If both the next cursor and previous cursor are missing, stop. Return the master list of items.

title: Employee Promotion Evaluator
spec: Write a function `promote(employees)` to determine eligibility. The input is a list of tuples containing employee name, recent score, previous score, project count, disciplinary count, leadership score, and peer review score. If the recent score is missing, disqualify them. If the previous score is missing, require the project count to be over five. If the disciplinary count is present, disqualify them. If the leadership score is present and over ninety, reduce the required project count by one. If the peer review score is missing, assume it is fifty; if it is present and under forty, disqualify them. Return a list of eligible employee names.

title: Account Profile Completeness Checker
spec: Write `validate(profile)` taking a tuple of eight elements representing a user profile: username, email, phone, address, biography, website, company, and title. Any of these elements can be a missing value. You must validate the profile according to specific rules. If the username is a missing value, validation immediately fails. If the email is a missing value but the phone is not a missing value, it is acceptable, otherwise it fails. If the address is a missing value, assign a default string. If the biography is a missing value, calculate the profile score as fifty, else eighty. If the website is not a missing value, add ten to the score. If the company is a missing value and the title is not a missing value, fail validation. If the title is a missing value, set it to a default. Return a tuple of a boolean indicating pass or fail, the final score, the address, and the title.

title: Environmental Sensor Calibrator
spec: Develop `calibrate(readings)` taking a tuple of eight environmental sensor readings: temperature, humidity, pressure, wind speed, wind direction, rainfall, solar radiation, and soil moisture. Each can be a missing value due to hardware faults. Process them sequentially. If temperature is a missing value, use twenty. If humidity is a missing value, use fifty. If pressure is a missing value, use one thousand. If wind speed is not a missing value but wind direction is a missing value, set speed to zero. If rainfall is a missing value, set it to zero unless humidity is over ninety, then set it to five. If solar radiation is a missing value, check if temperature is over thirty; if so, set it to high, else low. If soil moisture is a missing value and rainfall is greater than zero, set moisture to high. Return a tuple of all eight calibrated values.

title: Automotive Sensor Data Parser
spec: Create `process(telematics)` taking a tuple of vehicle data: speed, rpm, gear, fuel level, engine temperature, oil pressure, battery voltage, and tire pressure. Handle missing values for each. If speed is a missing value, estimate it from rpm if rpm is not a missing value, else set to zero. If gear is a missing value, infer it as drive if speed is greater than zero, else park. If fuel level is a missing value, flag a low fuel warning. If engine temperature is a missing value, default to ninety. If oil pressure is a missing value and rpm is not a missing value, flag an engine warning. If battery voltage is a missing value, use twelve. If tire pressure is a missing value, flag a maintenance warning. Return a tuple of the processed data and a list of generated warnings.

title: Payment Fraud Risk Analyzer
spec: Implement `score(transaction)` taking a tuple of transaction details: amount, currency, sender account, receiver account, timestamp, merchant category, country code, and ip address. Missing values indicate incomplete data. If amount is a missing value, score is zero. If currency is a missing value, default to dollars. If sender account is a missing value or receiver account is a missing value, reject the transaction. If timestamp is a missing value, add twenty risk points. If merchant category is a missing value, add ten risk points. If country code is a missing value, use the default local code. If ip address is a missing value and amount is large, add fifty risk points. Return a tuple of the final risk score, the currency, and the country code.

title: Datacenter Node Health Inspector
spec: Provide `analyze(metrics)` taking a tuple of server metrics: cpu usage, memory usage, disk space, network in, network out, active connections, load average, and uptime. Evaluate health despite missing values. If cpu usage is a missing value, assume fifty percent. If memory usage is a missing value, assume seventy percent. If disk space is a missing value, flag a disk warning. If network in is not a missing value but network out is a missing value, flag a network anomaly. If active connections is a missing value, set to zero. If load average is a missing value, compute it from cpu usage. If uptime is a missing value, flag a restart alert. Return a tuple of the estimated load, connection count, and a list of alerts.

title: Warehouse Dispatch Coordinator
spec: Write `route(order)` taking a tuple of order details: item code, quantity, warehouse id, shipping method, customer region, gift wrap flag, discount code, and delivery date. Missing values must be resolved. If item code is a missing value, cancel the order. If quantity is a missing value, set to one. If warehouse id is a missing value, check the customer region; if region is a missing value, use the central warehouse, else use a regional one. If shipping method is a missing value, default to standard. If gift wrap flag is a missing value, set to false. If discount code is not a missing value, apply a ten percent price drop. If delivery date is a missing value, calculate it as three days from now. Return a tuple of the resolved warehouse, shipping method, gift wrap, and delivery date.

title: Clinical Health Data Filler
spec: Develop `impute(record)` taking a tuple of patient data: age, weight, height, blood pressure, heart rate, cholesterol, glucose, and oxygen level. Fill in missing values using clinical defaults. If age is a missing value, default to forty. If weight is a missing value and height is not a missing value, estimate weight using a standard bmi. If height is a missing value, default to one hundred seventy. If blood pressure is a missing value, set to normal. If heart rate is a missing value, set to seventy. If cholesterol is a missing value, mark for testing. If glucose is a missing value, also mark for testing. If oxygen level is a missing value, assume ninety eight. Return a tuple of the completed record and a list of required tests.

title: Housing Market Asset Scorer
spec: Create `evaluate(property)` taking a tuple of property attributes: price, bedrooms, bathrooms, square footage, lot size, year built, garage spaces, and pool type. Address missing values to score the property. If price is a missing value, score is zero. If bedrooms is a missing value, assume two. If bathrooms is a missing value, assume one. If square footage is a missing value and bedrooms is not a missing value, estimate based on bedrooms. If lot size is a missing value, assume it equals square footage. If year built is a missing value, assume twenty years old. If garage spaces is a missing value, set to zero. If pool type is not a missing value, add twenty to the score. Return a tuple of the final score, estimated square footage, and lot size.

title: RPG Avatar Attribute Adjuster
spec: Implement `update(character)` taking a tuple of character stats: health, mana, stamina, strength, agility, intellect, armor, and weapon damage. Normalize missing values for gameplay. If health is a missing value, set to one hundred. If mana is a missing value, set to fifty. If stamina is a missing value, set to health divided by two. If strength is a missing value, set to ten. If agility is a missing value and strength is not a missing value, set to match strength. If intellect is a missing value, set to ten. If armor is a missing value, default to zero. If weapon damage is a missing value, default to bare hands damage of one. Return a tuple of all eight normalized stats.

title: Meeting Schedule Gap Filler
spec: Provide `resolve(event)` taking a tuple of event details: title, start time, end time, location, organizer, attendees list, category, and recurrence rule. Resolve missing values to finalize the booking. If title is a missing value, use a default meeting title. If start time is a missing value, booking fails. If end time is a missing value and start time is not a missing value, set end time to one hour after start. If location is a missing value, set to virtual. If organizer is a missing value, set to the system user. If attendees list is a missing value, create an empty list. If category is a missing value, set to general. If recurrence rule is not a missing value, mark the event as repeating. Return a tuple of a success boolean, the start time, end time, and location.

title: Model Hyperparameter Configurator
spec: Write `configure(params)` taking a tuple of eight hyperparameters for a model: learning rate, batch size, epochs, optimizer, loss function, momentum, weight decay, and dropout rate. Resolve missing values. If learning rate is a missing value, set it to point zero one. If batch size is a missing value, set to thirty two. If epochs is a missing value, default to one hundred. If optimizer is a missing value, use adam. If loss function is a missing value, use cross entropy. If momentum is a missing value and optimizer is not a missing value, set momentum to point nine. If weight decay is a missing value, set to zero. If dropout rate is a missing value, set to point five. Return a tuple of all eight configured hyperparameters.

title: Router Subnet Settings Resolver
spec: Develop `merge(settings)` taking a tuple of routing configurations: ip address, subnet mask, gateway, primary dns, secondary dns, mac address, vlan id, and mtu size. Apply defaults for missing values. If ip address is a missing value, use dynamic allocation. If subnet mask is a missing value, use standard class c. If gateway is a missing value, assume it is the first address in the subnet. If primary dns is a missing value, use public dns. If secondary dns is a missing value and primary dns is not a missing value, duplicate the primary. If mac address is a missing value, generate a random one. If vlan id is a missing value, set to one. If mtu size is a missing value, set to fifteen hundred. Return a tuple of the fully resolved network settings.

title: Employment Candidate Standardizer
spec: Create `normalize(application)` taking a tuple of applicant data: first name, last name, email, phone, resume text, cover letter, portfolio link, and references list. Process missing values for the hiring system. If first name is a missing value or last name is a missing value, reject the application. If email is a missing value, also reject. If phone is a missing value, note a communication warning. If resume text is a missing value, flag as incomplete. If cover letter is a missing value, set to a blank string. If portfolio link is not a missing value, add a bonus point to the score. If references list is a missing value, initialize an empty list. Return a tuple of a boolean for acceptance, the bonus score, and the references list.

title: Social Media Post Formatter
spec: Implement `format(post)` taking a tuple of post elements: author, text content, image url, video url, location tag, timestamp, hashtag list, and mention list. Prepare the post for display by handling missing values. If author is a missing value, use anonymous. If text content is a missing value, use an empty string. If image url is a missing value and video url is not a missing value, classify the post as a video post. If location tag is a missing value, hide the location pin. If timestamp is a missing value, use the current time. If hashtag list is a missing value, parse the text content for hashtags. If mention list is a missing value, initialize it as empty. Return a tuple of the author, classified post type, timestamp, and hashtags.

title: Culinary Dish Standardizer
spec: Provide `standardize(dish)` taking a tuple of recipe details: recipe name, serving size, prep time, cook time, ingredients list, instructions list, nutritional info, and difficulty rating. Fill missing values for the cookbook display. If recipe name is a missing value, use untitled. If serving size is a missing value, default to four. If prep time is a missing value, estimate it as ten minutes. If cook time is a missing value and prep time is not a missing value, set cook time to match prep time. If ingredients list is a missing value, return an error state. If instructions list is a missing value, append a default instruction. If nutritional info is a missing value, mark as unavailable. If difficulty rating is a missing value, set to medium. Return a tuple of the error state, name, servings, and cook time.

title: Project Management Task Initializer
spec: Write `initialize(task)` taking a tuple of task attributes: title, description, assignee, due date, priority, status, estimated hours, and parent project id. Setup the task by replacing missing values. If title is a missing value, use new task. If description is a missing value, use an empty string. If assignee is a missing value, assign it to the unassigned pool. If due date is a missing value, set it to one week from today. If priority is a missing value, set to normal. If status is a missing value, set to open. If estimated hours is a missing value and priority is not a missing value, estimate based on priority. title: Datagram Routing Analyzer
spec: Write a function decode(packets). Each packet is a tuple of seven elements: source address, destination address, payload length, checksum, sequence number, acknowledgment number, and urgent pointer. Elements can be missing (None). For each packet, start a list of string tags. If the source address is missing, append the string dropped. Else if the destination address is missing, append the string dropped. Else, analyze components independently: if the payload length is not missing, append the string loaded; if the checksum is missing, append the string risky; if the sequence number is missing, append the string unordered; if the acknowledgment number is not missing, append the string verified; if the urgent pointer is not missing, append the string priority; if the payload length is missing, append the string empty. Join the tags with a space and return the list of strings. For example, given [(None, None, None, None, None, None, None)], the output is ['dropped'].

title: Architectural Blueprint Checker
spec: Write a function check(blueprints). Each blueprint is a tuple of seven elements: foundation type, framing material, roof style, exterior finish, plumbing layout, electrical grid, and hvac system. Elements can be missing (None). For each blueprint, start an empty list of status notes. If the foundation type is missing, append the string rejected. Otherwise, check independently: if the framing material is not missing, append the string framed; if the roof style is missing, append the string open; if the exterior finish is missing, append the string draft; if the plumbing layout is not missing, append the string wet; if the electrical grid is not missing, append the string wired; if the hvac system is missing, append the string unventilated; if the exterior finish is not missing, append the string sealed. Join the notes with a space and return the list of strings. For example, given [(None, None, None, None, None, None, None)], the output is ['rejected'].

title: Espresso Maker Profiler
spec: Write a function configure(orders). An order is a tuple of three configurations: user preference, machine default, and factory setting. Each configuration is a tuple of four elements: water temperature, brew time, grind size, and milk froth level. Resolve the final settings for each order. For water temperature, if the user preference element is not missing (not None), use it; else if the machine default element is not missing, use it; else if the factory setting element is not missing, use it; else use the string standard. Apply this exact cascade independently for brew time, grind size, and milk froth level, always falling back to the string standard. Return a list of resolved four-element tuples. For example, given [((None, None, None, None), (None, None, None, None), (None, None, None, None))], the output is [('standard', 'standard', 'standard', 'standard')].

title: Vintage Car Restoration
spec: Write a function restore(cars). Each car is a tuple of eight elements: engine block, transmission, radiator, carburetor, exhaust pipe, steering wheel, dashboard, and seating. Any can be missing (None). For each car, order parts by starting an empty string list. Apply these independent rules: if the engine block is missing, append the string engine; if the transmission is missing, append the string transmission; if the engine block is not missing, append the string block ok; if the radiator is not missing, append the string radiator ok; if the carburetor is missing, append the string carburetor; if the exhaust pipe is missing, append the string exhaust; if the steering wheel is missing, append the string steering; if the dashboard is not missing, append the string dashboard ok; if the seating is missing, append the string seats. Return the list of string lists. For example, given [(None, None, None, None, None, None, None, None)], the output is [['engine', 'transmission', 'carburetor', 'exhaust', 'steering', 'seats']].

title: Weather Station Aggregator
spec: Write a function aggregate(stations). Each station reading is a tuple of eight elements: temperature, humidity, wind speed, wind direction, atmospheric pressure, rainfall, solar radiation, and cloud cover. If the temperature is missing (None), discard the reading entirely. For the rest, apply these independent corrections and append to a list: if the humidity is not missing, record it; if the rainfall is missing, record it as zero; if the wind speed is not missing, record it; if the wind direction is missing, record the string north; if the atmospheric pressure is missing, record one thousand; if the solar radiation is not missing, record it; if the cloud cover is missing, record zero; if the cloud cover is not missing, record it; if the solar radiation is missing, record fifty. Return a list of the corrected lists. For example, given [(None, None, None, None, None, None, None, None)], the output is [].

title: RPG Mission Tracker
spec: Write a function evaluate(quests). Each quest is a tuple of eight elements: quest giver, objective location, target enemy, required item, reward gold, reward item, time limit, and companion npc. Elements can be missing (None). For each quest, if the quest giver is missing, append the string hidden to the results. Otherwise, start a score at zero and apply these independent modifiers: if the objective location is not missing, add ten; if the target enemy is missing, subtract five; if the target enemy is not missing, add twenty; if the required item is not missing, add fifteen; if the reward gold is missing, subtract ten; if the reward item is not missing, add thirty; if the time limit is missing, add five; if the companion npc is not missing, add twenty; if the time limit is not missing, subtract fifteen. Append the score as a string. Return the list of strings. For example, given [(None, None, None, None, None, None, None, None)], the output is ['hidden'].

title: Camera Gear Packer
spec: Write a function pack(bags). Each bag is a tuple of eight elements: camera body, wide lens, telephoto lens, flash unit, tripod, spare battery, memory card, and microphone. Elements can be missing (None).
